biotools.summary: Ligand.MHC Atlas is a comprehensive atlas of MHC immunopeptidome in human cancer, providing a repository of HLA-presented ligands and annotations derived from large-scale immunopeptidomics data. The resource aims to accelerate the advancement of cancer vaccines and immunotherapies.
